formal_statement: ¬ (have x1 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))}; have x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => (∀ (x3 x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x3 - x4 ∈ x1 → x2.eval ((List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x6 = x3)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x6 = x4)) = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (x3 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x3.card = (4 : ℕ) → (∀ (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x6 ∈ x3 | x6 - x5 ∈ x1}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ)) → x2.eval ((List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x6 ∈ x3)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (∀ x7 ∈ x3, x7 - x6 ∉ x1)) = Bool.false; have x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∃ (x4 : ℕ) (x5 : ℕ), (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x3 x4).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x3 x5).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone (26 : ℕ) x3 x4 x5; ∀ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (26 : ℕ) x4 → x2 x4 → x4.size < (64 : ℕ) → x3 x4 → (∀ x10 ∈ x4.gates, x10.inputs.length = (2 : ℕ) ∧ x10.inputs.getD (0 : ℕ) (0 : ℕ) ≠ x10.inputs.getD (1 : ℕ) (0 : ℕ)) → (2 : ℕ) ≤ PEqualNP.TopForm.andPairs (26 : ℕ) x4 → ∃ (x12 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x12 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (26 : ℕ) x12 ∧ x2 x12 ∧ x12.size < x4.size)
plain_statement: It is false that: Plane of order 3 (line l = {l, l+1, l+3, l+9} mod 13; points then lines as 26 inputs). Call a fan-in-two AND/OR list reading earlier wires good if it is true at every incident point-line input and false at every quadrangle input. Let C be good, with fewer than 64 gates and some AND gate inside the cone of another AND gate. If every gate lists two different wires and at least two ordered pairs of AND gates have one inside the other's cone, some good list has fewer gates than C.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Part 1 of 2 of a proof of: Plane of order 3: every AND/OR list of fan-in at most two accepting every incident point-line input
